title: "People want to be victims" — a legally blind D1 athlete on why victimhood is easy
caption:
Asked whether victimhood has become the highest form of social currency, Aaron Golub (@aaronjgolub) doesn't dodge: people lean into it because leaning into pain is harder. A blunt take from a legally blind Division I athlete, pulled from 2026 - Success, Unscripted. Organisers putting together a motivational event or team kickoff can invite Aaron to deliver this one live.
